data.description:
Found in the AS-106 review (qa-priya, 2026-09-11). runCounted's post-teardown image check is images.filter(n => n.startsWith(project + '-')), which is the

-* glob AC-6 asked for — but compose image names are -, so any project whose name plus '-' prefixes another project's name matches that project's images too. Reproduced on the host with the real listing shape: project asc-impl-as108 against an images list containing asc-impl-as108-base-test:latest (present on this daemon today, from the AS-108 lane) -> exit 4, LEAK: asc-impl-as108-base-test:latest, for a run that leaked nothing. Fails safe (voids a good receipt; never passes a leaky one), so not blocking. Fix shape (implementer's call): ask docker for the project's own images (docker compose -p

images --format json, or filter by the com.docker.compose.project label via docker images --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=

) instead of a name prefix; the network side is already anchored at ^

_ and is fine. Falsifier: the fixture above must report clean.
data.title: Chat tooling: compose-run.mjs image leak filter <project>-* reports a sibling project's image as a leak (false exit 4)
